set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED='61659c3d516c3e1c0713d9c1d1ce50ba1d6c0893'; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; git fetch --no-tags origin main agent-control; test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "$EXPECTED"; python3 - <<'PY'
import json, subprocess
raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/agent-control:.agent/tasks/tracker-phase3-pre-field-golden-docs-v1.json'], text=True)
cmd=json.loads(raw)['commands'][0]
result=subprocess.run(['bash','-lc',cmd])
if result.returncode != 2:
    raise SystemExit(f'expected recorded v1 to stop at diff-check rc=2, got {result.returncode}')
PY
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('docs/QUALITY_GATE.md')
p.write_text(p.read_text().rstrip()+"\n")
PY
git diff --check; git status --porcelain | sed -E 's/^.. //' | sort > /tmp/golden-doc-paths; printf '%s\n' README.md docs/PHASE3_CODE_QUALITY_REVIEW.md docs/PHASE3_FIELD_COLLECTION.md docs/PHASE3_HANDOFF.md docs/PHASE3_PRE_FIELD_GOLDEN.md docs/QUALITY_GATE.md docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md | sort > /tmp/golden-doc-expected; diff -u /tmp/golden-doc-expected /tmp/golden-doc-paths; grep -F 'v1.0.0-phase3-pre-field.1' README.md docs/PHASE3_PRE_FIELD_GOLDEN.md docs/PHASE3_FIELD_COLLECTION.md >/dev/null; git add README.md docs/PHASE3_CODE_QUALITY_REVIEW.md docs/PHASE3_FIELD_COLLECTION.md docs/PHASE3_HANDOFF.md docs/PHASE3_PRE_FIELD_GOLDEN.md docs/QUALITY_GATE.md docs/STABILITY_RECOVERY_GUIDE.md; git diff --cached --check; test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l | tr -d ' ')" = '7'; git commit -m 'Freeze Phase 3 pre-field golden handoff'; git push origin HEAD:main; printf 'golden_docs_sha=%s\n' "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
